prompt:
Design a 5 V NE555 astable oscillator near 4.5 Hz, using E12 values where practical. Use standard astable connections: pin 8=VCC, pin 4=RESET tied to VCC, pin 1=GND, pins 2=TRIG and 6=THRESH share the timing node, R1 charge resistor connects VCC to pin 7 DISCH, R2 discharge resistor connects pin 7 to the timing node, and C1 connects timing node to GND. Add C2=10nF from pin 5 CTRL to GND. Pin 3 OUT drives a red LED through R3 in series to GND, with OUT port observing pin 3. Required components: U1 timer555 pins "1" through "8"; R1, R2, R3 resistors each pins A/B; C1 and C2 capacitors each A/B; D1 LED pins A/K; VIN, GND and OUT ports each pin 1. Include every required component and assign every listed pin exactly once. Every net needs at least two terminal IDs; terminal IDs must be REF.pin, never a net name. Return JSON only using the supplied response schema. Component ref strings must exactly be U1, R1, R2, R3, C1, C2, D1, VIN, GND, and OUT. The supply/ground/output terminals are VIN.1, GND.1, and OUT.1. Do not use generic names such as port.1. Net names may be any unique strings; connections are defined only by terminal membership. In components[].pins, list only the local pin names shown in parentheses (such as "1", "A", or "K"), never a full ref.pin string. For example, VIN has pins ["1"], while its net terminal is "VIN.1".
Response schema: {"topology":"string","components":[{"ref":"string","kind":"resistor|capacitor|led|timer555|port|ground","value":"string or null","pins":["string"]}],"nets":[{"name":"string","terminals":["REF.pin"]}]}
